product.title: Basmele copilăriei ilustrate de Tony Wolf. Mica sirenă și alte povești de H.Ch. Andersen
product.description: Poveștile ilustrate de celebrul ilustrator italian Tony Wolf recreează universul magic al copilăriei in culori și linii vesele, luminoase. De generații intregi, copiii se bucură să le asculte și le privesc fermecați, chiar inainte de a fi in stare să le citească.

Immerse your child in a world of magic with this beautiful collection of classic fairy tales. Featuring beloved stories from **H.C. Andersen**, including *The Little Mermaid*, these timeless narratives are brought to life through the enchanting illustrations of celebrated Italian artist, Tony Wolf. This book is a cherished piece of literature that has delighted generations of readers and listeners alike.

**Does it only contain *The Little Mermaid*?**
No. While it features *The Little Mermaid*, this collection includes several other cherished fairy tales penned by H.C. Andersen.
